profile.headline: Software Engineer II at BofA | GHC23 Speaker
profile.summary: Collaborative and solutions-driven Software Engineer with experience enhancing and optimizing enterprise-scale financial systems, including LoanIQ. Skilled in Java development, API integration, and SQL optimization, with a focus on improving performance, reliability, and scalability. Adept at root-cause analysis, refactoring complex codebases, and contributing to Agile/Kanban release cycles using Git and CI/CD pipelines. Passionate about building efficient, high-quality software that supports mission-critical lending and payment operations.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Led end-to-end development of a new LoanIQ SDK feature supporting ARM loan processing, implementing core business logic, validating financial calculations, and ensuring accurate values were displayed in the LoanIQ UI.
• Took ownership of complex production issues by tracing AutoSys batch job execution, analyzing downstream Oracle and SQL Server queries, and implementing durable code and query fixes.
• Diagnosed and resolved performance bottlenecks by rewriting inefficient SQL and optimizing batch workflows in high-volume lending systems.
• Designed and developed an internal AutoSys JIL parsing tool from scratch, improving visibility into batch configurations and reducing manual troubleshooting for the team.
• Used Dynatrace to identify JVM heap memory issues contributing to recurring Tomcat crashes, and implemented a custom AutoSys monitoring job to proactively track heap usage and alert the team before failures occurred.
• Regularly trusted to own unfamiliar problem areas, independently researching system behavior and delivering solutions in the absence of a subject-matter expert.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Contributed Java enhancements and refactors to the LoanIQ SDK, improving code maintainability and enabling new feature development.
• Investigated and resolved production issues via log analysis, job inspection, and targeted fixes to application code and database queries.
• Delivered unit- and integration-tested changes in Agile/Kanban cycles, ensuring reliable deployments across environments.
• Supported CI/CD workflows using Git, maintaining consistent version control and release processes for Java and .NET (C#) services.

positions.title: ERP Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Led a Git/GitLab research initiative and delivered a live demo to stakeholders, improving team understanding of version control and collaboration best practices.
• Installed and configured an Elastic/Kibana stack on Linux, enabling enhanced data analysis and visualization for internal teams.
• Deployed a standalone PeopleSoft server on a Linux VM, unblocking stakeholder evaluation of new ERP functionality.
positions.insights: Skills: PeopleTools · Git · Oracle SQL Developer · PeopleCode · Gitlab · PeopleSoft

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Built a Java utility to validate and compare REST APIs, improving developer productivity for the LoanIQ builder team.
• Developed a reusable Java password-tokenization tool, standardizing configuration generation across multiple repositories.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Bitbucket · Kanban · JSON · Agile Project Management

positions.title: Computer Science Instructor
positions.description:
• Taught fundamental programming concepts to over 10 students in one-on-one sessions and increased individual comprehension by over 100% in Java, Python, Scratch, and C++.
• Created assignments and projects integrating learned concepts, including loops, recursion, classes, inheritance, and methods.

positions.title: Tech Fellow
positions.description:
• Instructed a semester-long iOS mobile application development course to help students build three functional apps while focusing on design and implementation of RESTful API clients.
• Collaborated closely with Regional Program Manager and CodePath.org operations team to support, assess, and improve the student learning experience

positions.title: Manager, Research Support
positions.description:
• Implemented and outlined effective communications strategy to reach established All of Us Research Program goals and objectives.
• Measured campaign effectiveness by utilizing Google Analytics, URLs with UTMs, QR codes, SMS keywords, and short URLs.
• Designed visuals using Adobe Creative Cloud applications and services.

company.name: University of Miami,  Miller School of Medicine

positions.title: Assistant Director, Honors Program
positions.description:
• Strategized program requirements and pushed for improvements within our organization procedures by working closely with senior leadership.
• Managed the FSU Honors website by using the open source CMS platform Drupal and Bootstrap leading to increased website engagement and click rates.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant, International Programs
positions.description: • Worked closely with professor to develop an updated lesson plan for the “First Year Abroad” program and provide full support as-needed with any and all instructional responsibilities.

positions.title: Project Conversation Intern, Center for Leadership and Social Change
positions.description: • Encouraged students and faculty to facilitate discussion based on social justice awareness issues and worked with students on how to discuss "hot topics" in a respectful way.

positions.title: Orientation Leader, New Student and Family Programming
positions.description: • Coordinated and managed multiple networking events to facilitate relationship building among new and existing students.

honors.title: Kamala Scholar
honors.description: Selected to receive individualized career coaching sessions and invited to professional development webinars as a Latina GHC Student Scholar.

honors.title: Grace Hopper 2022 Student Scholar
honors.description:
Awarded a GHC Student Scholarship to attend the 2022 Grace Hopper Celebration in Orlando, FL. As a Student Scholar, I also gain access to scholars-only professional development workshops and a one-year membership to AnitaB.org.

#ghc22 #nextisnow #ghc #womanintech

volunteerExperiences.companyName: FSU Center for Intensive English Studies
volunteerExperiences.description: As part of the Language Partner Program, I worked with several international students over the course of four years. Through the program, I helped teach English to students from around the world.

company.name: FSU Center for Intensive English Studies
